name: Tensor math expression nodes
plain: Expression over whole tensors rather than scalars. CyWP TorchSymbolic has its own parser with a torch function table, no Python eval. TEX is a compiled per-pixel language that generates Python and execs it, so safety rests on its compiler. Eden and WJNodes eval over tensors. more_math is the widest in scope by its node list (Latent, Noise, Model, VAE, CLIP, Audio), but its source is not on disk, so it is listed from node names only.
math:
CyWP: parse(expr) → AST; eval with a,b,c tensors and a table of torch functions (no eval())
TEX: DSL → generated Python, exec of compiled code
Eden: eval(string, no builtins, {x:image}), clamp 0..1
more_math: not read; nodes LatentMathNodeOLD, NoiseMathNodeOLD, ModelMathNode etc.
